# Introduction

This vignette demonstrates how to use the WNNForecast package
for time series forecasting.

# Load package

```{r}
library(WNNForecast)



set.seed(123)
series <- sin(1:400/10) + rnorm(400,0,0.1)

model <- wnn_fit(series, lag = 20, k = 5)
pred  <- wnn_forecast(model, h = 20)

pred




library(readxl)

data <- read_excel("Elec-train.xlsx")
series <- data$Power_kW

model <- wnn_fit(series, lag = 96, k = 10)
pred  <- wnn_forecast(model, h = 96)

head(pred)




ts.plot(c(tail(series,200), pred),
        col=c(rep(1,200), rep(2,96)),
        lty=c(rep(1,200), rep(2,96)),
        main="WNN Electricity Forecast")

legend("topleft",
       legend=c("Observed","Forecast"),
       col=c(1,2),
       lty=c(1,2))
